summary: τ_N = ∑_y (translate by −y/N as last column) ⊗ (as last row) is a sum of names; the chain of pairs of lifts of these names equals, by `compUpTo_pairs_eq_smul`, a scalar times the chain with the data ω(diagN, diagN)(name of lastColDatum) applied to F^{ϱ+1}φ, the scalar being a product of character values at diagN, each of norm ≤ N^{2fb}.

steps.claim: Take t from the identity below; o: the lift kernel's ω at (g, k) on a name equals the name of the transformed function up to the character factor (`pairWeilFinite_name`).
steps.lean:
refine ⟨_, ?_, fun v φ a ↦ have o j f g k := eq_inv_smul_iff.2 (congr($(D.liftKernel_ω ϑ j) _ _
    ).trans (l.pairWeilFinite_name g f _ _ k (v j))).symm

steps.claim: w: lifting the translate of a form is translating the lift (`lift_equivariant`).
steps.lean:
have w j a b Φ φ := by simpa using
      (D.liftKernel ϑ j).lift_equivariant a b Φ (smoothFormRep _ _ a⁻¹ φ)

steps.claim: Rewrite the paired chain: τ_N is a sum of names (`translateSum_eq_sum_name`), diagN splits off the π-places, and pairTranslates and lastColDatum unfold.
steps.lean:
.trans (congrArg (compUpTo · _ _) (by ext; simp [TensorChain.liftInPairs,
      l.translateSum_eq_sum_name D.isSplitLevel_piPlaces, conjEmbedGL, diagN_eq_sdiff_mul
      D.piPlaces, pairTranslates, lastColDatum, charDatum, smul_sum, smul_smul, w,
      by simpa [↓spaceChar_rankTwist] using And.intro (o · · · 1) (o · · 1 ·⁻¹)]; rfl))

steps.claim: `compUpTo_pairs_eq_smul`: the chain of pairs equals a scalar times the chain of the modified data at F^{ϱ+1}φ, given the equivariance of each step under the general linear groups at the non-induced places (characters unramified at N, `charUnramifiedAt_rankTwist_of_N_mem`).
steps.lean:
(compUpTo_pairs_eq_smul D.nonInducedRep (L := fun j ↦ (D.liftKernel ϑ j).lift ∘ₗ _ ∘ₗ .applyₗ
      _ ∘ₗ name) (fun j ↦ ⟨fun b c f ↦ by simp [↓← funext (liftIntegralFn_mul (M := ·) l.reduction f
      b c), w, conjEmbedGL, by simpa [detCharAt_inclGL _ (D.charUnramifiedAt_rankTwist_of_N_mem _ _
      _ · <| l.natCast_mem _ ·)] using o j f (inclGL b) (inclGL c)⁻¹], fun φ ↦ by

steps.claim: The conjugation of the last-row datum by u₀ (`lastRowDatum_conj_u₀`), and φ is ramified (`mem_ramified_of_mem_ramifiedColumns`).
steps.lean:
simp [← funext lastRowDatum_conj_u₀, lastRowDatum, w,
      conjEmbedGL, by simpa [↓spaceChar_rankTwist, ↓card_X] using (o j · l.diagNInv l.diagNInv)]
    exact (inv_smul_smul (_ : ℂˣ) _).symm⟩) (mem_ramified_of_mem_ramifiedColumns _ a) _)⟩

steps.claim: |ιₚ(t)| ≤ N^{2mfb}: t is a product of detCharAt values at diagN (≤ N^{2fb} each, `norm_detCharAt_diagN_le`), over the ϱ + 1 pairs (m = 2(ϱ + 1)), times an integer factor of norm ≤ 1.
steps.lean:
simp; grw [norm_detCharAt_diagN_le, norm_detCharAt_diagN_le,
    IsUltrametricDist.norm_natCast_le_one, mul_inv_le_one_of_le₀] <;>
    (try gcongr) <;> simp [← rpow_mul_natCast, ← sq, m_eq_two_mul_varrho_add_two, prod_nonneg,
    norm_detCharAt_diagN_anti, D.n_mono _] <;> grind
